theme: Light theme (Primary) with Dark mode support. For engineering and compliance tools, a high-contrast Light mode ensures dense table readability and clear blueprint-style hierarchy.

fonts.body: IBM Plex Sans (sans-serif, highly legible for dense UI)
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono (monospace, critical for NBC clause references, measurements, and numerical data)

scale.clause_ref: font-mono text-xs text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 px-1 py-0.5 rounded-sm

rules: Never use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans.
Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Overlines and labels must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Line height: tight for headers, loose for body.
No full-screen gradients.
Use high-contrast monochrome base with functional accent colors.
Status colors must have matching tinted backgrounds for badges.
Never use pure black or pure gray; use slate (blue-tinted gray).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use border-collapse style layouts. Items should have border-r and border-b to expose the skeleton of the UI. Avoid soft UI and floating shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp edges or minimal rounded corners (max rounded-sm or 4px). Keep it architectural and crisp.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use purely functional drop-shadows on tooltips or dropdown menus only. Cards should rely on borders, not shadows.

layouts.grid_strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B) for Data-Heavy Dashboards.
layouts.spacing: Dense but clear. Use p-4 to p-6 for card internals. gap-4 or gap-6 for grid. Avoid massive padding in data tables.
patterns: Top Summary Card: Full width, highlighting Mixed Occupancy combinations via pill/chip list.
Building Parameters Wizard: Linear or stepped horizontal layout with distinct sections.
Compliance Blocks: Sectioned cards by NBC table/topic.
Fire-Fighting Installations Table: Dense table. Crucially, Wet Riser and Down Comer must be distinct, separate rows.
Expandable Rows: For NBC clause traceability, use accordion or expandable table rows to show the exact clauses.
Triggered BIS Standards: Small, dense grid of cards below the main compliance section.

components.badges: Square or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Font: JetBrains Mono text-xs. Color-coded by status (Required, Not Required, Conditional).
components.tables: Shadcn Table component. border-b on rows, hover:bg-slate-50. Data aligned based on type (numbers right, text left).
components.buttons: Sharp edges, flat design. Primary: bg-[#0A192F] text-white hover:bg-[#1E293B].
components.accordion: For NBC Clause traceability. 1px border, subtle gray background on header hover.
components.cards: Cardless or flat cards with 1px border-slate-200. No shadow.
components.forms: Shadcn components. Input fields with sharp borders, clear focus rings (ring-1 ring-[#0A192F]).

rules: Minimalist and functional.
Use micro-interactions for hover states (e.g., border color darkens, slight background tint).
Smooth accordion open/close for NBC clauses.
No bounce or spring animations. Use precise linear or ease-out transitions.
Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA standards (minimum 4.5:1).
Explicitly set text color on hover.
Focus rings must be high contrast.
Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='occupancy-select', data-testid='pdf-export-button').
Status indicators must use both color and text/icon (e.g., a red icon AND the text 'Required').

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (dense dashboards and developer tools). Regular or bold weight. Avoid cute or overly rounded icons.

login_background.description: Low angle photography of gray building at daytime. Architectural facade representing structure and engineering. Use with a dark overlay for login/hero.

blueprint_texture.description: Close-up of architectural blueprints. Use at very low opacity (e.g., 5%) as a background texture for headers or summary cards.

setup: Install required fonts: Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Install shadcn/ui components: table, badge, card, accordion, button, select, input.
implementation_steps: 1. Build the Page Layout: Top sticky header with app title and PDF export button.
2. Create the Building Parameters Wizard: Inputs for height, floors, area, basement, occupant load. Allow multi-select for occupancies.
3. Develop the Summary Section: Display entered parameters and mixed occupancy chips.
4. Build the Compliance Results Layout: Grid of cards for different NBC Part 4 topics.
5. Implement the Fire-Fighting Installations Table: Ensure 'Wet Riser' and 'Down Comer' are separate, explicit rows. Add status badges.
6. Add NBC Traceability: Use accordions inside table rows or cards to reveal specific table/clause notes.
7. Add BIS Standards & Missing Inputs: Sections at the bottom detailing required codes and next steps.
critical_requirements: Wet riser and Down comer MUST be separate cards/rows.
PDF export logic MUST be server-side (add a loading state to the export button).
Use the 'safety-calc-india' style: top summary, sectioned compliance blocks, status badges, reason text, clause references.
The UI must feel like an engineering tool, not a consumer app. Prioritize data density and precise alignment.

rules: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' AI slop outputs. No simplistic gradients, uniform styling, or generic centered layouts.
Never apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Do not use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, clear active states).
Use pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toast notifications.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for testing.
